description: This file contains unit tests for the Consistent Ring Provider functionality in the Orleans project, including tests for a consistent ring hash provider, virtual buckets distribution, and silo status management.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProviderTests
classes.description: A class containing multiple unit tests for different aspects of the consistent ring provider in Orleans.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISiloStatusOracle interface used for testing silo status behaviors.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test1
methods.description: Tests the basic addition of silos to the consistent ring provider and outputs their ranges.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test2
methods.description: Tests the virtual buckets ring provider with multiple silos and logs their ranges and states.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test3
methods.description: Simulates a large number of silos, their ranges, and queue distribution across the ring, outputting statistics.

methods.name: GetQueueHistogram
methods.description: Calculates and returns a histogram of queues assigned to each silo range.
